description: Comportement digues - surverse suite à rupture - Etat projet PAPI BSA 2055 - T0 module is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Behaviour of the dykes - overflow of the structure following rupture - as part of the modelling of the project state PAPI BSA horizon 2055 - Hydroclimatic scenario (Maritime M0 - River flow Module). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Behavior dykes - overflow following rupture - Project state PAPI BSA 2055 - T0 module" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include tempête, modélisation, Risque naturel, lutte contre les inondations, inondation, crue. The listing shows 2015-10-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
